Harrowfield had the largest 2025 budget per resident.

- Ossbridge: 9,284.5 million ÷ 52,904 = 175,494 tenge per resident
- Ashgrove: 10,488.1 million ÷ 58,760 = 178,486 tenge per resident
- Harrowfield: 16,021.7 million ÷ 90,212 = 177,601 tenge per resident

It exceeded the lowest, Ossbridge, by 2,107 tenge per resident.

ANSWER: Harrowfield | 2107
